collectible:1.text: A Dragon Priest Mask is a unique piece of headgear and can be obtained after defeating each of the eight unique dragon priests that appear in various locations throughout Skyrim. Each mask is unique in color and varies in smithing material. Each mask is named after their respective master and has unique effects; they are defined as either light or heavy armor.

collectible:3.text: Daedric Artifacts appear in The Elder Scrolls Online. Recovering some are part of the Mages Guild questline. Many can be worn cosmetically with the respective outfit styles obtained.

collectible:4.text: Word Wall is a creature card in The Elder Scrolls: Legends that is a part of the Heroes of Skyrim expansion. Word Wall can be purchased as part of the Paarthurnax's Roar deck or purchased alone for 50 soul gems. To gain the full effects from this card's power, Word Wall should be used in a deck with many shouts and played when the player has a shout in their hand.
